name: Custom Shape Wooden Keychain With Spinning Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a natural, lightweight, and durable finish for everyday use.
    - Made with 3mm thick wooden pieces, helping the keychain maintain its shape while keeping it easy to carry.
    - Designed with a custom-shaped main piece and a fun spinning charm for a more playful and eye-catching look.
    - Comes with a sturdy metal keyring, making it easy to attach to keys, bags, backpacks, purses, or accessories.
    - Includes a rotating mechanism that allows the charm piece to spin smoothly.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Main piece available sizes:
                +) 2 x 2 in ~ 5.08 x 5.08 cm
                +) 2.5 x 2.5 in ~ 6.35 x 6.35 cm
                +) 3 x 3 in ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm
                +) 3.5 x 3.5 in ~ 8.89 x 8.89 cm
    - Keyring length: 5 cm ~ 1.97 in
    - Rotating mechanism size:
                +) Width: 0.5 cm ~ 0.197 in
                +) Inner width: 0.4 cm ~ 0.157 in
                +) Thickness: 0.25 cm ~ 0.1 in
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Both the main wooden piece and the spinning charm feature 2-sided printing for a polished appearance from multiple angles.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized keychain and a decorative accessory.
    - Great for attaching to keys, handbags, backpacks, pencil cases, zipper pulls, and more.
    - The spinning charm adds an extra playful element that makes the keychain more eye-catching.
    - Lightweight and compact, making it easy to carry every day.
    - Perfect for personal use, themed collections, event favors, promotional items, or customized gifts.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun and meaningful gift for friends, family, coworkers, students, teammates, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, holidays, graduations, team celebrations, school events, party favors, and special occasions.
    - Ideal for sports fans, hobby lovers, collectors, and anyone who enjoys personalized accessories.
    - Great as a keepsake, souvenir, or promotional gift.
    - A creative gift choice that combines personalization, style, and interactive design 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Wooden Keychain With Spinning Charm

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
